In major courses, even when there were 40 seats, 50% of the students didn't get the course. This time, the course has only 30 seats.
300–400 level courses are supposed to be easier to get, but there isn’t a single seat available in any of them. We know the seats will gradually increase, but what’s the benefit of that? When they suddenly increase the seats, we won’t have any slot that time.
